title: Investor comparing DSCR lenders
scenario: Experienced landlord with four rentals is comparing lenders for a fifth property using a rental-income loan. He is curt and openly shopping around.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Abe? This is Simone with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I saw you inquired about an investment property loan. Is this a purchase?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Purchase. Duplex. I'm talking to three or four lenders, just comparing terms right now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Makes sense, you should compare. How many properties do you own currently?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Four. All long-term rentals.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Are you looking to qualify on the property's rental income rather than your personal income?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, DSCR. My tax returns look terrible on purpose.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, I hear that from a lot of investors. Do you know what the duplex will rent for?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Twenty-eight hundred combined, both units leased.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And the purchase price?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Three-ninety. What's your minimum down on these?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It varies by program and by how the rent covers the payment, so I'd want to look at the actual leases and your reserves before giving you a number.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Everybody says that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Fair. I'd rather give you something accurate than something that changes later. Can you send me the leases?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I can. I'm still just comparing, though. Not committing to anybody.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood, no commitment. I'll send a secure upload link and a short list of what we need.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: When's your inspection period up?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Ten days.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, I'll turn this around quickly. Thanks, Abe.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yep.
